mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kpis_information ( id, cycle_id, master_kpi_id, target_description, target_value, weight, is_important, created_by ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{cycleId}, #{masterKpiId}, #{targetDescription}, #{targetValue}, #{weight}, #{isImportant}, #{createdBy} )
mapper.select: SELECT ki.id AS kpi_information_id, ki.cycle_id, ki.master_kpi_id, km.is_global FROM kpis_information ki INNER JOIN kpi_master km ON km.id = ki.master_kpi_id WHERE ki.id = #{kpiInfoId} AND ki.deleted_at IS NULL AND km.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kpis_information WHERE master_kpi_id = #{masterKpiId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT ki.id AS kpi_information_id, ki.cycle_id, ki.master_kpi_id, km.type_code, km.category_id, km.name AS kpi_name, ki.target_description, ki.target_value, ki.weight, ki.is_important, km.unit_code, km.calculation_rule_code, km.calculation_type_code, km.is_global FROM kpis_information ki INNER JOIN kpi_master km ON km.id = ki.master_kpi_id WHERE ki.id = #{kpiInfoId} AND ki.deleted_at IS NULL AND km.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE kpis_information SET target_description = #{targetDescription}, target_value = #{targetValue}, weight = #{weight}, is_important = #{isImportant}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{kpiInfoId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT ki.id AS kpi_info_id, km.id AS master_kpi_id, km.code AS kpi_code, km.name AS kpi_name, km.category_id, kc.name AS category_name, km.type_code, km.unit_code, ki.weight AS kpi_weight, ki.target_value AS catalog_target_value, ki.target_description AS kpi_target_description, ki.is_important, d.id AS section_id, d.name AS section_name, mgr.id AS section_manager_id, mgr.full_name AS section_manager_name, ( SELECT r.code FROM user_roles ur INNER JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ur.user_id = mgr.id ORDER BY CASE UPPER(r.code) WHEN 'GM' THEN 1 WHEN 'PM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LEADER' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEMBER' THEN 4 ELSE 99 END, r.code LIMIT 1 ) AS section_manager_role_code, ( SELECT r.name FROM user_roles ur INNER JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ur.user_id = mgr.id ORDER BY CASE UPPER(r.code) WHEN 'GM' THEN 1 WHEN 'PM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LEADER' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEMBER' THEN 4 ELSE 99 END, r.code LIMIT 1 ) AS section_manager_role_name, u.id AS member_id, u.full_name AS member_name, ( SELECT r.code FROM user_roles ur INNER JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ur.user_id = u.id ORDER BY CASE UPPER(r.code) WHEN 'GM' THEN 1 WHEN 'PM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LEADER' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEMBER' THEN 4 ELSE 99 END, r.code LIMIT 1 ) AS member_role_code, ( SELECT r.name FROM user_roles ur INNER JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ur.user_id = u.id ORDER BY CASE UPPER(r.code) WHEN 'GM' THEN 1 WHEN 'PM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LEADER' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEMBER' THEN 4 ELSE 99 END, r.code LIMIT 1 ) AS member_role_name, ldr.id AS leader_id, ldr.full_name AS leader_name, ( SELECT r.code FROM user_roles ur INNER JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ur.user_id = ldr.id ORDER BY CASE UPPER(r.code) WHEN 'GM' THEN 1 WHEN 'PM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LEADER' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEMBER' THEN 4 ELSE 99 END, r.code LIMIT 1 ) AS leader_role_code, ( SELECT r.name FROM user_roles ur INNER JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ur.user_id = ldr.id ORDER BY CASE UPPER(r.code) WHEN 'GM' THEN 1 WHEN 'PM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LEADER' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEMBER' THEN 4 ELSE 99 END, r.code LIMIT 1 ) AS leader_role_name, jt.name AS member_rank, ka.id AS assignment_id, ka.status_code, ka.mid_self_score, ka.end_self_score, ka.end_pm_score, ka.end_gm_score, ka.target_value AS member_target_value FROM kpis_information ki INNER JOIN kpi_master km ON ki.master_kpi_id = km.id AND km.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN kpi_categories kc ON km.category_id = kc.id AND kc.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN kpi_assignments ka ON ka.cycle_id = ki.cycle_id AND ka.kpi_info_id = ki.id AND ka.user_id IS NOT NULL AND ka.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = ka.user_id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN user_departments ud ON ud.user_id = u.id AND ud.is_primary = TRUE LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id = ud.department_id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN users mgr ON mgr.id = d.manager_id LEFT JOIN users ldr ON ldr.id = ud.supervisor_id LEFT JOIN job_titles jt ON jt.id = u.job_title_id AND jt.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ki.cycle_id = #{cycleId} AND ki.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY km.code NULLS LAST, km.name, d.name, u.full_name
